property.name: size
property.label: Size
property.description: Add any valid CSS value for spacing. You can also use negative values to remove space between other components. This LWC doesn't include sibling margin and adds paddings or reduces margins to adjust spaces.

property.name: sizeM
property.label: Size M
property.description: Same as above but this only applies to medium breakpoints.

property.name: sizeS
property.label: Size S
property.description: Same as above but this only applies to small breakpoints.
